caption: The drawing depicts three pieces of jewelry, arranged against a plain, light beige background. At the top left, there is an earring featuring a gold hook, a green leaf-shaped base, and three red teardrop-shaped pendants hanging from it. At the top right is another earring with a gold hook and loop, adorned with two small red teardrop-shaped pendants and a small green leaf accent. At the bottom center is a larger brooch or pendant composed of intertwining gold loops, from which several red teardrop-shaped pendants hang, interspersed with multiple green leaves with yellow accents. The color palette prominently features gold, vivid green, and bright red, with the gold elements providing structure and the leaves and pendants as decorative highlights.
title: Brooch and Earrings
